text:
Ava (sales): Heads up — two customers opened nearly identical asks to control a per-tenant UI 'compact mode' toggle that affects left-nav density. Tickets: SUP-2104 + ACCT-993. Can we consolidate into a single canonical request and give an ETA so I can reply to both? :eyes:
Priya (PM): Thanks @Ava (sales). Can you paste the exact ask from each customer? Are they requesting a feature flag for admins or a user-level preference?
Ava (sales): Quick paste from SUP-2104: 'Need per-tenant compact nav toggle so we can show more content on dashboards for internal power users.' ACCT-993: 'Customer wants denser left nav at account level to reduce horizontal scroll.' Both mention admin control.
Priya (PM): OK sounds like same ask. I'll create canonical CR-4821 and merge. Criteria: admin toggle exposed in org settings + preserved layout spacing tests + rollout killswitch. Any engineering notes?
Carlos (eng): From an infra side, this is low-risk. Two options: (A) CSS variable + feature flag (fast, ~2-3 dev days) or (B) admin UI for toggling with audit log (adds ~1-2 weeks). Recommend (A) as MVP and follow-up for admin UI. Tagging P2.
Sam (design): For MVP we can ship the density flag without a full admin screen — just respect the flag in CSS and default to 'standard' for existing orgs. Need 1 design review for edge cases (icon spacing, focus state).
Devon (support): I'll draft the reply to both customers once we have CR id and ETA. Prefer to give them the MVP timeline and note admin UI is scheduled separately.
Mia (product ops): Assigning ownership: @Priya (PM) will own the canonical CR, @Carlos (eng) will triage implementation and @Sam (design) will sign off on the UI changes. I'll add tags: duplicate-merged, customer-impact, P2, frontend.
Priya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria I'll add to CR-4821: 1) org-level toggle applied to all users; 2) toggle persisted in org settings; 3) no regressions on dashboard widths; 4) telemetry event on toggle change. Any additions?
Carlos (eng): Also add: fallback to 'standard' if toggle missing and a rollout killswitch env var.
Ava (sales): Great. Please confirm ETA for MVP so I can message customers.
Priya (PM): Tentative: MVP in 2 sprints (approx 3 weeks) assuming no blocker. I'll put a canary rollout plan in the ticket.
Devon (support): Draft message for customers (ready to send once CR linked):
```
Hi — thanks for the request. We consolidated your asks into CR-4821 ("per-tenant compact nav toggle"). Planned MVP: small density flag that admins can enable; ETA ~3 weeks for initial rollout. We'll follow up with admin UI timeline separately. We'll let you know when we have a beta available and can add you to early access.
- Support Team
```
Priya (PM): That looks good — @Ava (sales) feel free to send once I confirm CR link.
triage-bot: Linked SUP-2104 and ACCT-993 to CR-4821 and marked both as duplicate->merged.
Mia (product ops): Final note: I'll post status update to both customers and add the following tags in our backlog: canonical:CR-4821, customer-notified, release-target:next. :thumbsup:
Ava (sales): Thanks everyone — sending reply now and I'll cc backlog link when live.
